{"metadata":{"description":"use a GitHub Copilot subscription as a DSH LLM provider","id":"gh:1353498848","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-provider-copilot","slug":"youngrock-labs/dsh-provider-copilot","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","github-copilot","llm-provider"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"use a GitHub Copilot subscription as a DSH LLM provider"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-provider-copilot"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Bridge a **GitHub Copilot subscription** into **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** as a plain LLM provider."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Scope"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- ✅ Chat completions (streaming)

- ✅ `/copilot login | logout | status` commands"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"
- ✅ JSONL observability with strict field allowlist
- ❌ Tool / function calling (explicitly out of "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"scope)
- ❌ Copilot CLI runtime / FFI (not used)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The package is a dsh **plugin bundle**: a cordis object plugin

registration — no dsh source changes are needed."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Inside dsh the streamed response uses the harness chunk protocol
(`block-start` / `text-delta` / `re"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"asoning-delta` / `block-end` / `usage` /
`finish`); `reasoning` deltas render in dsh's collapsible ""},{"id":"p9s3","text":"thinking" row.
The adapter is plain chat: it never forwards `tools`, and dsh handles that
fine — an "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"assistant reply without tool calls ends the turn normally."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Sequence: first call after login"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Non-public API notice"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"This project uses `api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token` to exchange a
GitHub OAuth token for a "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"Copilot bearer token. That endpoint is a
**non-public, unstable interface**; GitHub may change or re"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"voke it at any
time. Use in production at your own risk."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Additional compliance notes:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- User-Agent must start with `GitHubCopilot*`; anti-scraping otherwise returns

- The plugin ships the official VSCode Copilot Chat OAuth `client_id`

- The Device Flow scope is `read:user` only. No repository / gist / issue
scopes are req"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"uested.
- dsh requires app attribution on every provider HTTP request; the Copilot
endpoints additio"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"nally require the `GitHubCopilot*` User-Agent. Verify the
header combination you ship against a live"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" request before release."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The package is a dsh **bundle**: its manifest declares `dsh.bundle` and it

registered when the host comm"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"and service is present (dsh Web resolves `/`
lines against them):"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`/copilot login` returns the GitHub verification URL and the one-time code
to enter there; authoriza"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"tion continues in the background once you approve
it in the browser:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"In dsh's model picker (the group is visible from install, see above),
select a model inside the **Co"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"pilot (GitHub)** group. Selecting a model
makes it the default for new sessions; each session keeps "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"its own recorded
selection. Pick again any time to switch models. Sending a request requires
a crede"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ntial: set `COPILOT_TOKEN` / `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`, or run
`/copilot login` above. Once signed in, "},{"id":"p26s5","text":"the advertised list is intersected
with the upstream `/models` catalog."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Usage — programmatic (BYOK)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Token source priority"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`AuthManager` resolves credentials in this order:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"1. `byok` constructor option — a `{ kind: "bearer" | "github", token }`.
2. `env COPILOT_TOKEN` — a "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"raw Copilot bearer; skips exchange.
3. `env COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` — a GitHub token; drives exchange."},{"id":"p31s3","text":"
4. On-disk OAuth cache from a previous `/copilot login`.
5. `~/.config/gh/hosts.yml` (opt-in: `DSH_"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"COPILOT_ALLOW_GH_HOSTS=1`).
6. `GH_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN` (opt-in: `DSH_COPILOT_ALLOW_ENV_GH=1`)."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Sources 5–6 are opt-in because "any GitHub token" leaking into a
Copilot-specific credential surface"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" is easy to do by accident."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Env var                       | Effect                                                     |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| `COPILOT_TOKEN`               | Skip exchange; use as Copilot bearer directly.             |
| `CO"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"PILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN`        | GitHub token to exchange for a Copilot bearer.             |
| `DSH_COP"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"ILOT_ALLOW_GH_HOSTS`  | `1` enables reading `gh` `hosts.yml` as fallback.          |
| `DSH_COPILOT_"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"ALLOW_ENV_GH`    | `1` enables reading `GH_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN` fallback.  |
| `DSH_COPILOT_NO_LO"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"G`          | `1` disables JSONL log writes (no directory / files).      |
| `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`      "},{"id":"p35s6","text":"       | Standard XDG override for cache & log location.            |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Observability"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **In-memory ring buffer:** last 10 successful calls used for
`/copilot status` p50/p95.
- **JSONL "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"log:** `~/.config/dsh/copilot/log/copilot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`.
Fields are a hard-coded allowlist:
`ts,"},{"id":"p37s3","text":" requestId, event, model, latencyMs, promptTokens, completionTokens,
totalTokens, errorCode, source,"},{"id":"p37s4","text":" sku`.
Any attempt to log outside that set is rejected at runtime.
- **Retention:** 7 days by defaul"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"t; pruning is lazy on the first write
of a new UTC day; failures are silent.
- **Perms:** dir 0700, "},{"id":"p37s6","text":"files 0600, matching auth cache."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"| Symptom                                        | Likely cause / fix                               "},{"id":"p39s2","text":"                                                     |"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"| `403 scraping` from `api.github.com`           | Non-Copilot UA.
